issue_context.title: support forcing to stop the task in the pool

review_comments: Not get point. Why need shard here?

In the future, we need to schedule the task with the task manager while we will add or delete the task in the task manager from the user business. Lock contention is a bit intense so we add the shard lock.

```DeleteTask``` has been added in ```TestTaskManager``` which is at the ```resourcemanager/pooltask/task_test.go```. ```StopTask``` is in the ```TestStopPool``` which is at the ```util/gpool/spmc/spmcpool_test.go```
Could we remove this function or remove `Done`? It seems that `f.Done` and `f.Finish()` do the same thing: `t.wg.Done()`
In fact, They are the same thing. But if Finish is also called, here are two ```Done```. it is weird. ```Finish``` is to tell system this ```TaskBox``` has finished job.

> Could we remove this function or remove `Done`?

If we remove it, we will block when to exit.
